message.content:
"Drive My Car" (Rubber Soul, 1965) is primarily sung by Paul McCartney, with John Lennon joining on the chorus.

- John Lennon: 0.7 (he shared lead on the chorus/refrain)
- Paul McCartney: 0.98 (main lead vocal)
- George Harrison: 0.1 (backing vocal only, plus guitar solo)
- Ringo Starr: 0.01 (drums only)
message.reasoning_content: Paul lead; John shared? Commonly John did backing/lead together on chorus. Lead vocal: Paul and John shared? Actually Paul sang lead, John and George backing. Some say Paul & John. I'll say Paul 0.95, John 0.5? Chorus sung together. I'll include John 0.6.
